content:
Overview

Turin is a city in Piedmont with a population of 848,000. An elegant city at the foot of the Alps, home to FIAT, the Shroud of Turin, Baroque architecture, and a renowned culinary scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
